title: EntitiesDefinition
description: Game pieces (Terrain, Units, Constructs) that can occupy the hex grid.

controllerUrl.description: Path to the JS module defining the controller class

rotationOffset.description: Y-axis rotation offset in degrees to orient GLB model correctly

sightRange.description: Vision sight range in hex cell radius

spawnConditions.description: Conditions required to spawn or build the entity on a hex cell.

terrain.description: List of allowed terrain type names the entity can be spawned on.

minSeparation.description: Minimum cell distance from any other construct entity.

elevationAdjustment.description: Multiplier/divisor applied based on relative elevation between attacker and target.

sfx.description: Sound effect file names for entity events, relative to sfx.basePath. 'action' may be a file name or an object keyed by action name.

select.description: Played when the entity is selected

anyOf.description: Maps lowercased action names (e.g. move, attack) to file names; 'default' is the fallback.

action.description: Played when the entity performs an action

build.description: Played when this construct finishes building

damage.description: Played when the entity takes damage

destroy.description: Played when the entity is destroyed
